patterns.note: Full-width sections with a strong dark background, often featuring large, custom illustrations that span the width of the viewport, creating a visually immersive experience.
Prominent use of oversized, bold, uppercase display typography for key messages and section headings, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impactful statements.
A primary dark green background (#122315) is consistently used, contrasted with a vibrant accent green (#55dd4a) for CTAs and highlights, and warm orange/yellow tones in illustrations.

The hero section features a multi-layered illustration that parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and revealing more of the scene, while the initial hero text scrolls out of view to be replaced by subsequent large headings.
Many sections integrate custom, hand-drawn, nature-themed illustrations as core visual elements, rather than relying on photography, to convey brand values and context.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered illustration where different elements move at varying speeds during scroll, creating a parallax effect that adds depth and dynamism to the initial view.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging Lottie, are used to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
A sticky navigation bar at the top and a persistent call-to-action button at the bottom right ensure continuous access to key site functions and conversion points.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong visual impact, while body text remains legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and cards, maintaining a clean yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable line spacing within text blocks, contributing to a premium and uncrowded presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of custom, hand-drawn, nature-themed illustrations, particularly the dynamic parallax hero, creates a unique and memorable brand identity that sets it apart from typical corporate finance platforms. This visual storytelling, combined with bold typography, gives the site a playful yet authoritative feel.
